detail.longDescription: Docker Hub Side: I added a new repository called: test-jenkins that is public I added a PAT on Docker Hub PAT is expired after 90 days The permission for PAT was: Read, Write & Delete On Jenkins Side: I added a maven job with some configurations for git For Post-Steps I chose 'Docker Build and Publish' Repository Name: username/test-jenkins Tag: test-jenkins-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT$BUILD_NUMBER Registry credentials: here I added new credential using username and password For the username: username For the password: PAT from Docker Hub Description: docker So I was able to select the credential: username/ **** (docker) Apply and save Now for building: cloning from github is working clean, test, install are working When it comes to docker Post-Step, I'm getting: push access denied, repository does not exist or may require authorization: server message: insufficient_scope: authorization failed Build step 'Docker Build and Publish' marked build as failure Finished: FAILURE Note: Building the image and pushing it from the terminal is working perfect.
